components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1c1c1a; color: #fff; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; font: 560 14px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Input
components.css: .ds-input { height: 44px; border: 1px solid #e6e4de; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 12px; font: 14px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; background: #fff; color: #1c1c1a; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; }

components.name: Nav item
components.css: .ds-nav-on { display: block; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #1c1c1a; font-weight: 560; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #e6e4de; text-decoration: none; font: 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Hospital mark
components.css: .ds-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 9px; background: #2b4054; color: #fff; font: 650 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Interfaz de hospital extraída del panel desk: papel cálido, tipo de sistema, cifras tabulares.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: El verde no pinta fondos ni titulares.

rules.name: The Same Face Rule
rules.body: No introducir una segunda familia para dar marca.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Si hace falta alzar, un anillo de 1px.
